name: Advocate
overview: The topic of Advocate in Scripture, as illustrated in Acts 24:1-6, involves the role of an orator or representative who speaks on behalf of others, exemplified by Tertullus presenting accusations against Paul before Governor Felix. This passage highlights the function of an advocate as one who formally pleads a case, sometimes to accuse or defend, within legal and communal settings. The use of Advocate figuratively can extend to representing interests or making a case for a person or group, as seen in the context of Tertullus's address.
